svg.text: ROS2 Pipeline POC — topology & threads (live video)

manager reads a video and paces admission (backlog-based, drops rather than pausing) → fans out to A (metadata) and B→C (image chain, C optional) → both return to manager, which burns metadata onto the frame and streams it live over UDP
metadata branch · does NOT stamp the image
MAIN THREAD (rclpy.spin, manager_node.py) + 2 background threads: video_source.py (decode) · gst_sink.py (stream writer)
LIVE STREAM OUT — gst_sink.py: background worker thread (gst-launch-1.0 writer)
on join (frame_sync.py pairs out_c + metadata_a for frame_id): burn_metadata_on_frame() (frame_codec.py) → gst_sink.send()
GstSink worker thread: queue.get() → gst-launch-1.0 stdin.write() → MJPEG/RTP over UDP → GST_UDP_HOST:GST_UDP_PORT
consumed outside the pipeline, e.g. gst-launch-1.0/ffplay on the devcontainer host (see scripts/relay-stream.sh)
Main thread — rclpy executor, one callback
at a time; on_frame only enqueues (never blocks).
Worker thread — A/B/C: fake work + publish, off
the executor. manager has two: video_source.py paces
video decode; gst_sink.py drains a queue into
AND B → C (image chain; C optional via
RTPS/UDP — full serialize + copy each hop.
Fast DDS Data-Sharing over shared memory. Not the
same as ROS2 loaned messages (unavailable in rclpy).
